sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile), Yin Release, Combo

system.description:
Your fists and feet erupt into fiery black chakra as you fuse your attacks with the power of false molding. If you have a nature release affinity, you can grant this jutsu that nature release (or one if you have multiple), and the associated effect, or choose the Yin Release effect.

With your body suffused with Yin Chakra you strike out with a series of blows foretelling where your opponent will try to dodge or avoid from. Make a melee Taijutsu attack dealing your [Unarmed Damage] and forcing the target to make a Constitution saving throw based, applying the listed effect based on the nature release chosen.

Yin Release. The affected creature has their chakra network infiltrated as they increase the cost of the next jutsu they cast by +6.

Earth Release. You mold Yin Release to forcibly drag pillars of stone from the earth trapping the enemies feet and knocking them Prone.

Wind Release. You mold Yin Release and release a powerful twister of chakra pushing them 20 feet back and leaving them Dazed.

Fire Release. You mold Yin Release and ignite your strikes with black false flames as the target gains 1 rank of Concussed.

Water Release. You mold Yin Release and overwhelm them with waves of chakra being Dazzled.

Lightning Release. You mold Yin Release chakra and strike them again, piercing their defenses, the next time you deal damage to them before the end of the current turn, gains Pierce 4.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage you deal by +1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, when using the Yin Release effect, increases the chakra cost penalty by +6. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, when using the Yin Release effect, increases the chakra cost penalty by +6.
